scope: One exact production runtime in an isolated BDS boot. Synthetic query issuers, native blocks and canonical records. Compare separate matched boots for whole-runtime deployment cost, including all source differences; no real multiplayer.
timingNote: Date.now measures JS workload wall time at millisecond resolution. Effective TPS includes paced waits; mean tick interval is not active engine MSPT. Use native diagnostics for active tick categories.

nativeDiagnostics.definition: Complete native capture: sum of level_tick + script_tick + script_job_tick in milliseconds, no paced sleep. Includes short start/stop guards and any collector history; not filtered by JS currentTick because observed offsets can omit first-work spikes.
